tier1.headline: Your Biometric Data Collected
tier1.quote: Measurements of bodily functions, vital signs, or characteristics, including photographs, which may also be considered biometric information under the MHMDA, the NHDPA, or other applicable state consumer health privacy law.

tier1.headline: Your Data Improves Products
tier1.quote: Primarily, we collect and use consumer health data as reasonably necessary to provide you with the products you have requested or authorized.

tier1.headline: Your Data Collected From Third Parties
tier1.quote: As described further in the Personal data we collect section of the privacy statement, we collect personal data (which may include consumer health data) directly from you, from your interactions with our products and services, from third parties, and from publicly available sources.

tier2.headline: Your Data Shared Internally
tier2.quote: We enable access to data across our subsidiaries, affiliates, and related companies, for example, where we share common data systems or where access helps us to provide our services and operate our business.

tier2.headline: Your Location May Reveal Health
tier2.quote: For example, if you use Bing maps to get directions to a health care provider, we may collect GPS, cell tower, and Wi-Fi hotspot location data that could reveal health-related information.

tier2.headline: Your Data Used For Advertising
tier2.quote: We may use consumer health data for other purposes for which we give you choices and/or obtain your consent as required by law – for example, for advertising or marketing purposes.

tier2.headline: Your Data Transferred Globally
tier2.quote: A full list of specific affiliates is available here.

tier2.headline: Your Data Disclosed To Authorities
tier2.quote: As described in our privacy statement and our Law Enforcement Requests Report, we disclose data to law enforcement or other government agencies when we believe doing so is necessary to comply with applicable law or respond to valid legal process.
